import pathlib, subprocess, os, hashlib, json
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
scratch=pathlib.Path(os.environ['TMPDIR'])/'harborline/t493-succession'
producer=root/'projections/dotnet/foundation/hlp.foundation.taxonomy/TaxonomyInterpreter.cs'
original=producer.read_bytes()
project='projections/dotnet/foundation/hlp.foundation.taxonomy.tests/Harborline.Foundation.Taxonomy.Tests.csproj'
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
env=dict(os.environ,DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER='0',MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE='1')
build=['dotnet','build',project,'-c','Release','--no-restore','-m:1','-nr:false']
test=['dotnet','test',project,'-c','Release','--no-build','--no-restore','--filter','FullyQualifiedName~TaxonomyPinnedSuccessionTests','-m:1','-nr:false','--logger','console;verbosity=normal']
def run(args,name):
    with (scratch/name).open('w') as log:
        result=subprocess.run(args,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env)
    print(name, 'exit', result.returncode, flush=True)
    print('\n'.join((scratch/name).read_text().splitlines()[-16:]),flush=True)
    return result.returncode
mutations=[
 ('ignore-requested-version','return definitions.TryGetValue(coordinates, out var definition) ? new ResolvedTaxonomyDefinition(definition) : new TaxonomyDefinitionNotFound(coordinates);', 'var definition = definitions.Values.LastOrDefault(d => d.Tenant == coordinates.Tenant && d.DefinitionId == coordinates.DefinitionId);\n        return definition is not null ? new ResolvedTaxonomyDefinition(definition) : new TaxonomyDefinitionNotFound(coordinates);'),
 ('omit-successor-edge-update','            current = successor;','            // mutation: current = successor;'),
 ('omit-last-hop-assignment','LastHopCode = previous.Code','LastHopCode = null'),
]
results=[]
for name,before,after in mutations:
    try:
        text=original.decode()
        assert text.count(before)==1, name
        producer.write_text(text.replace(before,after))
        assert run(build,name+'-build.log')==0, 'build failed'
        red=run(test,name+'-red.log')
        assert red!=0, 'mutation survived'
    finally:
        producer.write_bytes(original)
    assert run(build,name+'-restored-build.log')==0
    green=run(test,name+'-restored-green.log')
    assert green==0
    results.append({'mutation':name,'baseSha':head,'redExit':red,'restoredExit':green})
    (scratch/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
assert producer.read_bytes()==original
print('ALL THREE MUTATIONS DETECTED AND RESTORED',flush=True)
